$comment: Canonical motion spec for AI page generation, grounded in real CSS/JS in src/ — not invented timings. Closed to the real, evidence-grounded set of fields actually in use (MASTER-GUIDE 3.7); a PageSpec motion object with additionalProperties beyond these must be rejected by schema/pagespec.schema.json and schema/semantic_validate.mjs.

reveal.description: Scroll-triggered fade+rise applied via a shared `.reveal` class and one IntersectionObserver instance per route, not per-element measured CSS transitions.
reveal.evidenceNote: The original drives this motion through Framer's JS runtime with no CSS transitions to read (README.md 'Known interpretations'). This clone's `.reveal` implementation is an IntersectionObserver equivalent that reproduces the visible effect, not a byte-for-byte copy of the original's internal motion engine. Do not claim more precision than this — the duration/easing/distance values below are this clone's own real, shipped CSS values (src/index.css), not measured off the live Framer site.

implementation.triggerBehavior: fires once per element (observer.unobserve after intersect), re-queries all `.reveal` targets on every route change (src/App.jsx Layout)

reveal.reducedMotionFallback: Element renders fully visible with no opacity/transform transition — .reveal.is-visible's end state applied immediately.

marquee.description: Infinite horizontal looping strip built from a duplicated-and-doubled track.

implementation.technique: Track holds two identical halves; translateX(-50%) lands exactly on the seam so the loop is invisible.

marquee.reducedMotionFallback: animation: none — track renders statically at its resting position.

autoAdvanceCrossfade.description: Auto-advancing two-tab accordion whose active tab cross-fades the paired screenshot stack.
autoAdvanceCrossfade.evidenceNote: Structural behavior (fixed 1048px clipped band, two tabs, auto-advance, cross-fade) is confirmed against src/components/Pillars.jsx. This spec does not assert a specific auto-advance interval or cross-fade duration as a separately measured foundation token — Pillars.jsx is the sole implementation and source of truth for those exact values; a generator should treat the component's own internal timing as authoritative rather than expecting a named token here.
autoAdvanceCrossfade.reducedMotionFallback: First tab shown statically; no auto-advance timer runs; no cross-fade transition on manual tab selection.

viewportGatedPlayback.description: Video plays only while its containing frame is on screen; pauses when scrolled out of view.
viewportGatedPlayback.reducedMotionFallback: Video does not autoplay; the screenshot/poster frame is shown in its place.

loop.description: Simple infinite video loop with no viewport gating beyond what viewportGatedPlayback already covers for the same element.
loop.reducedMotionFallback: Video loops without an explicit pause control; if the browser itself suppresses autoplay under reduced-motion, the poster frame is shown.

buttonPress.reducedMotionFallback: No scale transform on press; button still responds to click/tap.

globalReducedMotionRule: All marquee + reveal motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (tokens/tokens.json#motion.reducedMotion). Every pattern above states its own specific fallback; none may omit reducedMotionFallback in a generated PageSpec node.
closedFieldSetNote: schema/pagespec.schema.json's motion.allowed items enum is locked to exactly this list — an invented pattern name (e.g. 'parallax', 'typewriter') must be rejected, since nothing in src/ implements it.
